summary: Iteration 75 - Wallet, Analytics, and CVL BRAIN testing. All 14 backend tests passed. Fixed rate limiter bug that was blocking /api/my-wallet routes. Frontend wallet page displays real data from MongoDB (balance, chart, stats). Rate limiting (429) affected some frontend testing.

minor.issue: Was being rate limited (429) because rate limiter only skipped /api/wallet, not /api/my-wallet. FIXED by adding /api/my-wallet to skip list.

tests_passed: GET /api/my-wallet/me returns balance, balance_eur, chart_points, packs, monthly stats
GET /api/my-wallet/history returns real transaction list from MongoDB
POST /api/my-wallet/buy-pack with pack_id=culture adds 16 jetons and returns new_balance
All wallet endpoints require authentication (401 without session)
POST /api/analytics/track stores single event in site_events collection
POST /api/analytics/batch stores multiple events (tested with 3 events)
GET /api/analytics/site-stats returns overview, top_pages, devices, timeline
Asking about CC2026 returns event details and subtly suggests next steps (badge, wallet)
Asking about CVLN redirects smoothly without explicit refusal
Asking about GAFAM/Google/Meta redirects to building own cultural space
Asking about Jeton CC returns value (1.50€) and pack information
Wallet page loads at /espace-pro with WALLET nav item
Displays real balance from DB (93 CC = 139.50€)
Shows balance chart with trend indicator (+6.9%)
4 action buttons: RECHARGER, ENVOYER, ECHANGER, TRADING
Monthly stats: Dépense, Reçu, Économisé, Valeur EUR

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed rate limiter in server.py line 135: added /api/my-wallet to skip list
Wallet routes correctly use /api/my-wallet prefix (not /api/wallet) to avoid conflict with fintech.py
Session cookie is set with secure=True which requires HTTPS for browser to send it
CVL BRAIN knowledge base (cvl_brain_knowledge.py) correctly implements 5-level anticipation and confidentiality redirects
seed_data_creation: None - using existing admin account with 93 CC balance
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 75 completed. Wallet endpoints (/api/my-wallet/*) are fully working with real MongoDB data. Analytics endpoints (/api/analytics/*) working for tracking and stats. CVL BRAIN anticipation and confidentiality working. Rate limiter was fixed to skip /api/my-wallet routes. Admin user has 93+ CC balance from test purchases. The 429 rate limiting is aggressive (200 req/60s) and affects frontend testing when many API calls are made.

mocked_apis.note: All endpoints are real DB operations - no mocking

bug_fixed.root_cause: Rate limiter middleware in server.py line 135 only skipped /api/wallet but wallet routes are under /api/my-wallet
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added /api/my-wallet to the skip list in rate_limit_middleware
